businessSummary: A B2B SaaS platform that helps logistics companies track shipments and manage fleet maintenance.
audience: Logistics operators, fleet managers, and supply chain teams in mid-size transportation companies.

reasons.team: The customer is a software product; the team is not the customer-facing draw, so no team section.

palette.rationale: Slate and blue feel technical and trustworthy for B2B software; amber accent highlights calls to action.
